messages:
anika_cs: FYI — customer 'Zenith' opened a ticket after last night's deploy. They see session resume failures and truncated context on regen. They say ~40% of regen attempts fail with empty or partial outputs. Attaching repro and a few call IDs below. Can we triage for eng intake?

anika_cs: Repro steps (as customer sent):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-4k",
  "session_id": "zenith-abc-001",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following..."}
  ],
  "stream": false
}
# Then: make two regen requests within 500ms each, then restart the client (close socket) and immediately send another regen. Observe truncated context / empty reply.
```

anika_cs: Call IDs: c_78a1, c_78a2, c_78b9. Logs in the support ticket + heap snapshots attached. Customer is on Dedicated with committed capacity and asked for ETA.

sam_product: Thanks Anika. Tagging @kevin_eng for engineering triage. Quick Qs for prioritization: how many customers affected (besides Zenith)? Is this a deploy-only regression or intermittent? Do we have an easy rollback? Need product impact to decide hotfix vs backlog.

kevin_eng: Looking at the logs Anika uploaded — stack trace points to kvcache eviction in runtime when worker restarts and reconnects. Repro looks related to short inter-regeneration sequences + session reconnect. Might be a race in kvcache restore.

kevin_eng: Need exact model variant + runner binary hash from the customer (we saw they were on redwood-4k@v2.3.1). Also need staging repro. If repro is reliable on staging we can estimate: patch+unit tests ~2d, canary 24-48h. Hotfix (prio) could be done in ~8-12h but risks incomplete test coverage.

olga_support: Customer confirms model variant: redwood-4k@v2.3.1. Traffic: low QPS (~1-2 rps) but bursty. They are willing to pin to v2.3.0 as a temporary workaround. They've asked us not to roll them back to previous infra without notice.

kevin_eng: Ok. For engineering intake I need: 1) a deterministic repro on staging (preferably with a small script), 2) stack trace + worker logs (we have), 3) target acceptance criteria (what counts as fixed). Proposed acceptance: no truncated outputs in 10k regen attempts in staging and KV cache remains consistent across restarts.

sam_product: Launch criteria from Product: 1) Reproducer in staging + automated test; 2) Patch in main with code review and perf check; 3) Canary at 1% for 24h with error delta <= 0.5%; 4) Customer confirmation on Dedicated. If hotfix chosen, CS must get exec sign-off for emergency change.

anika_cs: Customer wants ETA. They prefer hotfix. They'll accept pin to v2.3.0 for now if we can give a firm ETA for a permanent fix. Also they asked that any hotfix not add >10ms p99 latency.

kevin_eng: Noted. I'll try to reproduce on staging now. If I get a clean repro, I'll open PR-4821 (patch branch) and post the link. If staging repro fails, we'll need a debug build from the customer's environment. Assigning to devon_oncall to keep eyes on it.

oncall-bot: @devon_oncall assigned to thread (incident-mode: triage).

devon_oncall: Ack. I'll run the repro script in staging and capture KV cache snapshots and metrics. If repro is reliable, I'll prepare a canary rollout plan.

sam_product: Thanks all. Product note: keep this in 'high-priority backlog' until fix or safe workaround confirmed. CS please update the ticket with the workaround (pin to v2.3.0) and get customer sign-off for potential hotfix.

anika_cs: Will do. Adding: customer explicitly requested rollback option if hotfix causes regressions. Logged in ticket.

kevin_eng: Quick technical note for the patch: likely fix is to add a prefix-guard during KV restore to avoid stale keys overriding active session state, plus a race-condition guard around worker rebind. I'll post proposed diff after initial repro.

anika_cs: :+1: thanks — updating Zenith and will ping here once they confirm pin.

devon_oncall: Update 30m: reproduced reliably in staging with the script (attached). Opening PR and will mark for 1% canary tomorrow morning. PR link: (internal) /repo/redwood-service/pulls/4821

sam_product: Good progress. Keep product + CS looped for canary start. Marking this for roadmap discussion next weekly triage if recurring across customers.

anika_cs: Thread closed for now from CS side; will reopen if customer declines workaround or if hotfix ETA changes.
